'''Hall''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Organa Marines|Marine]] [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] in the forces of [[House of Organa/Legends|House Organa]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War]]. He led a detachment of Organa marine forces to assault [[Castle Panteer]] in the [[Glarus Valley]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], hoping to retake the castle from [[House Ulgo]], but he and his forces were instead wiped out by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
